title: Delivery Lead - PEGA
description:
**Job Description:**
* Lead end\-to\-end delivery of complex Pega programmes and projects.
* Manage delivery scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, risks, issues and stakeholder expectations.
* Coordinate Business Architects, Solution Architects, System Architects, developers, testers, DevOps and production\-support teams.
* Ensure delivery is aligned with Agile methodology, governance standards, quality expectations and contractual commitments.
* Act as the primary delivery interface between the client and implementation team.
* Drive delivery planning, sprint execution, release management and production deployment.


**Key Responsibilities:**
* Own project/programme delivery outcomes \- scope, timeline, cost, quality and benefits.
* Prepare delivery plans, milestones, release schedules and the critical path.
* Manage scope, risks, issues and dependencies (RAID).
* Manage project resources, delivery capacity, onboarding and ramp\-up/ramp\-down.
* Own financials \- budget forecasting, burn tracking, change control and commercial variance management.
* Facilitate governance meetings and steering committees.
* Track delivery progress and key metrics \- velocity, cycle time, escaped defects.
* Coordinate architecture, development, testing and deployment activities.
* Manage change requests and delivery impacts.
* Ensure quality gates, entry/exit criteria and guardrail compliance targets are met.
* Coordinate release management, cutover planning, go\-live readiness, hypercare and transition to support.
* Support estimation and commercial planning.
* Manage stakeholder, client and vendor communication and relationships.
* Escalate and resolve delivery blockers.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and governance.
* Drive continuous improvement across delivery teams through retrospectives and lessons learned.


**Technical Qualification: Minimum knowledge, skills, abilities needed:**
* Strong understanding of the Pega implementation lifecycle and Pega Express delivery.
* Understanding of Pega architecture, development and testing processes.
* Strong Agile/Scrum knowledge; SAFe or scaled Agile exposure.
* Experience with Jira/Azure DevOps or equivalent tools; Pega Agile Studio exposure.
* Strong knowledge of project planning and delivery governance.
* Understanding of CI/CD and release management.
* Strong risk, dependency and issue management skills.
* Financial and commercial management \- budget, forecast and change control.
* Strong stakeholder\-management and communication skills.
* Understanding of cloud and enterprise technology environments.


**Educational Qualification:**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or Business Administration.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate management qualification preferred.


**Preferred Qualification:**
* 10\+ years of IT experience.
* 5\+ years managing Pega/technology programmes.
* PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, SAFe Agilist or equivalent certification (mandatory baseline).
* Agile certification \- CSM, PSM I/II or SAFe Scrum Master.
* Certified Pega Business Architect (CPBA) is preferred.
* Certified Pega System Architect (CPSA / CSA) is preferred.
* SAFe Release Train Engineer (RTE) or SAFe Program Consultant (SPC).
* PgMP; ITIL v4 Foundation for support transition.
* Experience managing large\-scale enterprise transformation programmes.
* Experience managing multiple workstreams and teams of 20\+.
* Experience with client governance and executive reporting.
* Experience with fixed\-price, T\&M and managed\-service commercial models.
* Experience of multi\-vendor and distributed/offshore delivery.
* Financial services/insurance experience is advantageous.
* Experience in commercial management and pre\-sales is an added advantage.

Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) initiative ‘Same Difference’ is committed to fostering an inclusive culture – promoting equality, diversity and an environment that is respectful to all. title: Assistant Vice President Operations
description:
At Rocket India, we don't just process mortgages — we reimagine how people achieve the dream of homeownership. We're on a mission to simplify, accelerate, and humanize the home financing journey, and we need bold, experienced leaders who've lived and breathed US mortgage originations to help us do it at scale. If you're someone who thrives on building high\-performing teams, driving operational excellence, and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in lending — this is your launchpad.
 



  





 About the Role
 


* Lead and scale end\-to\-end US mortgage origination operations, driving efficiency, quality, and an exceptional client experience across the origination lifecycle
* Build, mentor, and inspire large cross\-functional teams across loan processing, underwriting support, closing, and post\-close functions
* Define and execute strategic roadmaps aligned with Rocket's origination volume targets, compliance standards, and technology\-driven transformation goals
* Partner closely with US\-based stakeholders, product teams, and technology leaders to streamline workflows, reduce cycle times, and eliminate friction in the borrower journey
* Champion a data\-driven culture by establishing KPIs, SLAs, and performance dashboards to monitor productivity, accuracy, and turnaround times
* Stay ahead of evolving regulatory requirements (TRID, RESPA, ECOA, state\-specific guidelines) and ensure all origination activities remain fully compliant
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives leveraging automation, AI, and digital tools to modernize origination processes
* Serve as a thought leader and subject matter expert on US mortgage origination best practices, market trends, and competitive landscape
* Own talent strategy for the originations vertical — including hiring, upskilling, succession planning, and retention of top talent
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and relentless client focus that reflects Rocket's core values



  





 About You
 



 Minimum Qualifications
 


* 13 to 20 years of progressive experience in US mortgage originations, with a strong track record in leadership and operational management
* Deep expertise across the full origination lifecycle — from application through closing — including conventional, FHA, VA, and jumbo loan products
* Proven experience managing and scaling teams of 100\+ professionals in origination operations
* Strong working knowledge of US regulatory frameworks including TRID, RESPA, ECOA, HMDA, and state\-level lending regulations
* Demonstrated ability to drive process optimization, digital transformation, and operational excellence at scale
* Exceptional stakeholder management skills with experience collaborating across geographies, particularly with US\-based teams
* Strong analytical mindset with experience leveraging data and metrics to inform decisions and drive performance
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related field



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Experience working within or partnering with top US mortgage lenders, servicers, or fintech organizations
* Familiarity with Rocket's technology ecosystem or similar mortgage technology platforms (Encompass, Black Knight, ICE Mortgage Technology)
* MBA or advanced degree in a relevant discipline
* Experience leading operations in a GCC (Global Capability Center) or offshore/nearshore delivery model
* Certifications such as Certified Mortgage Banker (CMB) or equivalent industry credentials
* Track record of successfully launching new origination verticals, products, or market expansions
* Passion for mentoring the next generation of mortgage professionals and building a culture of learning



  





 What You Will Get
 



 At Rocket India, we believe that when our people win, everyone wins. As an Originations Leader, you'll be part of a high\-energy, purpose\-driven organization that invests deeply in its people. You'll enjoy competitive compensation, comprehensive health and wellness benefits, and opportunities for continuous professional development. Beyond the tangible perks, you'll get the rare chance to shape the future of US mortgage originations from India — working with cutting\-edge technology, world\-class talent, and a leadership team that genuinely values bold ideas. Here, your impact won't just be measured in numbers — it'll be felt by every family you help get closer to home.
 



  





 About Us
 



 Rocket India, registered as NSM Services Private Limited and formerly Mr. Cooper, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Rocket Mortgage, LLC, headquartered in Detroit, Michigan. As a core part of Rocket's global ecosystem, Rocket India helps shape the future of home financing through technology, innovation, operations, product, and customer\-focused solutions. Our teams build scalable platforms and digital experiences that simplify mortgage origination and servicing while supporting Rocket's mission to "Help Everyone Home."
 



*We are committed to providing a fair and inclusive workplace for all team members and applicants. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, religion, caste, disability, or gender identity, consistent with applicable Indian law, including the Constitution of India, the Code on Wages, 2019, the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, and the Transgender Persons (Protection of Rights) Act, 2019\. We welcome applications from persons with disabilities and from all sections of society.*

title: Lead Engineer – Alignment
description:
It has been more than 60 years since SYSTRA has garnered expertise that spans the entire spectrum of Mass Rapid Transit System. SYSTRA India’s valuable presence in India roots back to 1957, where SYSTRA worked on the electrification of Indian Railways. Our technical excellence, holistic approach and the tremendous talent provides a career that puts people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency.
   

  

 Understand better who we are by visiting www.systra.in
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water Infrastructure for public and private organizations.
   

  

 CTR – Regional Technical Centre of Systra India takes care of the international production of major projects at Systra Group level. CTR team has expertise in design of High\-Speed Rail, Metro, Conventional Rail, Bridges, Highways, Depots, Stations and Transport Planning. Starting from Feasibility/Concept stage to Detailed Design to IFC/Shop drawings, the disciplines involved have experience of designing in accordance with various international codes and delivered projects across the world.
   

  

 CTR team has successfully delivered some major projects in UK, UAE, Tanzania, KSA, Australia, Canada and Denmark. One of the major achievements of India CTR team has been the design of HS2 project in UK. We played an instrumental role in delivering 3 major Sublots on HS2 with our teams proactively engaging with Front Office in UK and delivering beyond client expectations. This resulted in India team receiving many accolades from the contractor BBV and client HS2\.
   

  

 CTR team in India is proficient in working on multi\-disciplinary projects integrating Design, BIM and Drawing production in a seamless workflow incorporating different software. The technical and management teams within CTR get an opportunity to work and interact with other CTR teams within Systra Group from Paris, Poland, Dubai, Philippines and Brazil.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead the review of complex design deliverables, including plan profile drawings, detail cross\-sections, BOQ etc..
* Ensure design teams develop optimal solutions that meet project requirements, maintaining high standards of quality and innovation.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior designers and team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development.
* Oversee the technical review process for all projects within your teams, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to industry standards.
* Take ultimate responsibility for the financial and quality performance of projects within your discipline, creating a culture of ownership and accountability.
* Manage complex design projects independently, from feasibility through detailed design, ensuring timely and successful delivery.
* Lead resource planning and delivery strategy within tender teams, ensuring successful bids and alignment with project goals.
* Drive innovation within your team by staying informed on sustainable development, standardization, automation, and future trends and technologies.
* Organize your teams to adopt new technologies and methodologies, ensuring your team's skills remain relevant and competitive.
* Ensure compliance of the Systra Group policies, particularly on ethics, safety and adherence to Company ISO Standards.
* Promote and maintain good relationships with all internal and external parties to enhance the reputation of the Team and the company


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech degree in a relevant engineering field (e.g., Civil Engineering, Railway Engineering, Transportation etc.)
* 10\+ years of experience in a design environment on range of civil engineering projects that include Rail infrastructure. Track record of leading and managing complex projects independently.
* Skilled user of Bentley Open Rail Designer, Bentley Rail Track, Civil 3D.
* Knowledge of creating templates, Corridor modelling, Cross section, Design of turnout, Super elevation, Regression analysis
* Detailed knowledge of multi\-disciplinary issues associated with Rail Alignment design
* Detailed knowledge of construction principles and standards including Rail Alignment Design Codes (AREMA/UIC/EN)
* Experience of team management, mentoring and development
* Proven involvement in major projects and complex design work, with evidence of risk assessments, technical analysis, and case studies.
* Expertise in industry\-relevant design tools and a commitment to continuous professional development.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a proven ability to build and maintain relationships at all levels.


 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

title: Platform Support
description:

 Working closely with Sales, Product, Technology, Finance, and Legal teams, the role enables scalable growth, improved partner experience, and efficient lifecycle management across cloud transactions and subscriptions.

* Exposure to marketplace platforms, pricing governance, and automation initiatives

title: Lifestyle Manager
description:
About Pinch
 




  






 The last decade and a half has been dedicated to the rise of convenience in every way. Organisations, one after the other, have created products and services which make the life of customers convenient. Yet the pain, pressure and stress of the modern world has not really reduced, leave aside going away.
 




  






 At Pinch, our dream is to transform the physical environment of a family and help them create space for the truly important things, allowing them to focus on themselves and their mental well\-being to build a meaningful life, filled with purpose and joy. We wish to build a home management system, which not only does the daily chores, seamlessly and effortlessly, but also preempts the needs of our customers, enhances their lifestyle in every
 





 aspect while giving them the peace of mind to focus on achieving more in life. From full housekeeping to a quick tidy up or a dog walk, Pinch is available for the families all the time. We work as an extension of our customers’ family and bring to the table what is best for them.
 




  






 With our monthly plan, we combine services such as housekeeping, maintenance, food \& nutrition management, grocery resupply, laundry management, etc. tailored to the unique needs of each family. On top, a dedicated Lifestyle Manager helps them with any miscellaneous home requests, from decorating home with fresh flowers to arranging a repairman for the broken washing machine, to planning details of the next holiday, taking care of children or the elderly. Basically, anything and everything our customers and their families would need to live a comfortable, convenient, healthy, guilt\-free, and inspired life.
 




  






 How will we do it?
 





 There are three fundamental aspects of our business model which will help deliver this life\-transforming service:
 




  






 Lifestyle Manager: Armed with irrefutable professional attention, prompt service, strict quality controls and effective anticipation of needs, our dedicated lifestyle team helps customers in a variety of things. Be it sending flowers on birthdays, reminders for paying bills on time, and even recommending the latest home products. Our team of lifestyle managers are mapped to each family, do all the research, analysis and short list the best products and service experience for the customers.
 





 Trained Professionals: Offering a much more professional service than domestic helpers, with Pinch, customers are served by a team of home specialists who will handle all the housework, chores and running around. If they already have a helper, we will have them trained by us to maximise their potential and effectiveness.
 





 Technology: We take the hassle out of home management. Customers are given constant home and personal management advice, reminders and nudges, where the back\-end system incorporates an algorithm that remembers preferences and generates instructions to meet our customers’ home goals.
 




  






 Pinch has 4 broad customer segments:
 



* Individuals \& Families
* Landlords \& Second Home Owners
* Developers \& RWAs
* Corporates



  





*The Lifestyle Manager – An Extension of the Customer’s Family* 




  






 A Lifestyle Manager at Pinch is deeply empathetic, has a natural attitude towards helping people and is committed to improving lives for the better. Every family has their own set of needs, wants, preferences \& behaviours. Our Lifestyle Manager understands this, has the ability to develop a deep bond with a family \& its members, and designs solutions keeping their specific requirements in mind. S/he is warm, courteous, patient \& a good listener, with an eye for detail. S/he is able to not just solve for what the customer asks, but even anticipate or pre\-empt their needs, through her/his deep understanding of the family. Our customer’s peace of mind relies immensely on the Lifestyle Manager, and how efficiently and swiftly s/he works with the other teams at Pinch to be able to meet the customer’s requirements. The Lifestyle Manager has a service\-oriented mindset that puts the customer first, even before the company. Practically, s/he is an extension of the customer’s family \& thus, the most important link between the company \& the customer.
 




  





*Responsibilities of a Lifestyle Manager* 




  






 1\. Customer Onboarding
 



* Understand the prevailing context in a customer’s life with respect to the services we intend to provide.
* Explain how Pinch can help ease the customer’s life by delivering these services in a transformative manner.
* Handhold \& onboard the customer seamlessly onto Pinch’s ecosystem of services.



  






 2\. Solution Deployment
 



* Define \& agree upon the interventions needed for fulfilling the customer’s requirements.
* Deploy a set of trained domestic helps at the household to take care of the day\-to\-day chores, \& undertake periodic supervision of their work.
* Assign errands to the Operations Associates and monitor them for completion to the family’s satisfaction.



  






 3\. Partner Management
 



* Work with Pinch’s central partner ecosystem to deploy solutions at the customer’s household and fulfil any new requirements from time to time.
* Onboard and work with a local set of quality partners in the immediate vicinity of the customer’s location to bring about greater efficiency.
* Oversee the quality of work done by the partners and provide valuable feedback to the central Partnership teams on the same.



  






 4\. Customer Lifecycle Management
 



* Have deeper dialogues and conversations with the customer that ease them into the Pinch journey across the 5 stages of pain, convenience, pleasure, delight \& transformation.
* Educate and enable customers to adopt a wider range of Pinch’s services.



  






 5\. Customer Feedback \& Service Improvement
 



* Determine customer satisfaction with regard to the various services provided by Pinch.
* Identify \& work on areas of improvement. Iterate the solution design to continually keep enhancing customer service.
* Raise \& highlight any complaints, queries, grievances, feedback etc. to the relevant teams for resolution.



  






 Who are we looking for?
 



* Candidate with Hospitality background
* Candidate with communication and public relation skills
* Candidate with Event management, language and intercultural communication background
* Passionate about the cause the company is working towards
* Excited about wanting to work in a start\-up
* Self\-motivated \& loves taking initiative
* Growth mindset, focussed on improving business outcomes
* Able to hustle, loves being out on the ground, \& is willing to get his/her hands dirty
* Embraces ambiguity \& uncertainty
* Focused on problem\-solving, has a solution\-oriented mindset
* Hard\-working, is able to work for long hours
* Excellent team player
* Ability to multitask on multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to handle pressure and failure



  






 Qualifications:
 



* Bachelor's degree preferably in hospitality.

 Enterprise software is entering a third era. The first gave manufacturers a System of Record — ERP that answered 'what do we have and what did we commit to?' The second gave them Data Infrastructure — the ability to move, analyse, and query that data at scale. The third era is domain\-specific intelligence: AI agents that can act autonomously on manufacturing data, but only if that data has been given the context, relationships, and governed rules that allow an agent to reason correctly.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**Company Description** 
 \-
 



 Medhavi Skills University (MSU), Sikkim, was established under The Medhavi Skills University, Sikkim Act 2021, with a mission to integrate the skilling ecosystem into higher education. MSU follows a pioneering model where employers, corporates, and industries actively shape curriculum design, programme delivery, and practical skills training, while also offering on\-the\-job apprenticeships and internships. The university aims to become a leading institution for skills\-based education recognized by employers in India and abroad, emphasizing flexible learning, competency\-based modular courses, and credit transfer across educational streams.  The Manager will be responsible for establishing and strengthening partnerships with healthcare institutions, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, clinics, NGOs, and industry partners to facilitate On\-the\-Job Training (OJT), clinical postings, internships, fieldwork, and experiential learning opportunities for students of Psychology and Allied Health Sciences. The role also involves developing and managing Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with partner organizations to support student training, research, and industry engagement initiatives.
 



  





**Qualifications \-** 




**1\. Industry Partnership Development**



* Identify, approach, and onboard hospitals, clinics, diagnostic centers, rehabilitation centers, mental health organizations, NGOs, and healthcare providers for student training and placement opportunities.

**3\. MoU Development \& Management**



* Draft, process, and coordinate Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, and industry partners.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of partnership agreements.
* Maintain records and documentation related to all industry collaborations and MoUs.
* Coordinate with legal, administrative, and academic teams for approvals and execution of agreements.



  





**4\. Stakeholder Coordination**



* Act as the primary point of contact between the university and partner organizations.
* Organize industry meetings, partnership discussions, and review sessions.
* Facilitate communication among students, faculty members, and industry partners.



  





**5\. Compliance \& Documentation**



* Maintain a database of industry partners, clinical sites, and training organizations.
* Prepare periodic reports on student postings, industry engagement activities, and partnership outcomes.
* Ensure compliance with university policies, accreditation requirements, and regulatory guidelines related to clinical training.



  





**6\. Student Support \& Career Development**



* Guide students regarding internship and clinical posting requirements.
* Support employability initiatives and facilitate industry interactions.
* Assist in organizing workshops, guest lectures, industry visits, and career\-oriented activities.



  





**Qualifications \& Skills Required:** 



* Master's Degree in Psychology, Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, Social Work, Allied Health Sciences, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Additional certifications in healthcare management or industry relations will be an advantage.
* 5 \- 10 years of experience in industry relations, healthcare partnerships, training coordination, placement activities, or academic\-industry collaboration.
* Experience in working with hospitals, healthcare institutions, NGOs, or educational institutions is preferred.
* Strong networking and relationship management skills.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal abilities.
* Knowledge of healthcare and mental health ecosystems.
* Experience in drafting and managing MoUs and partnership agreements.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office and database management.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to architect and scale a future\-focused, industry\-integrated higher education ecosystem.
* Competitive compensation with performance\-linked incentives.
* Leadership role in a rapidly growing national skills and university platform.
* A collaborative, mission\-driven environment.
* The opportunity to create a measurable impact on employability and workforce transformation at scale.

description:
**We are hiring of Head of Program for Programme Management Consultancy Worldclass Infrastructure Project Andhra Pradesh.**
**Qualification**
 Graduate in Civil Engineering with mandatory international project experience
   

  

**Desirable**
 Post\-graduate in Civil Engineering / Construction or Project Management; PMP or equivalent certification from a recognized international body
   

  

**Experience Required — 15\+ years**

* At least 8 years on large\-scale urban infrastructure or greenfield city development works
* At least 5 years leading a planning/programme\-controls function across multiple concurrent contracts
* Demonstrated experience in master scheduling, baseline control, variance analysis and recovery planning on multi\-package portfolios
* Working command of Primavera P6 / MS Project and programme dashboarding
* Externally funded project experience (ADB/World Bank/JICA); FIDIC and Indian public\-works contract forms; prior experience ramping up a planning function from a low base.


**Role And Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and ramp up the Construction Planning \& Project Management function for the APCRDA PgMC, covering the portfolio of 95 projects with an aggregate contract value of approximately ₹50,999 Cr
* Establish an integrated programme\-level master schedule covering LPS Infrastructure, H\&B, Trunk Infrastructure, Flood Mitigation, Water Supply, Electrical Infrastructure and CIIP projects
* Exercise independent charge of planning approach, sequencing and resource deployment within the function, within delegated technical and commercial authority
* Manage and coordinate the project planning teams across divisions and enforce consistent planning, scheduling, reporting and project\-control practices
* Review and consolidate contract\-wise baseline programmes, milestones, resources and key interfaces, and establish a common picture of current and upcoming construction activities
* Monitor progress against approved plans and drive recovery and action plans for delayed projects, with focused attention on work\-fronts where cumulative progress is substantially below plan — presently LPS Infrastructure, H\&B, Trunk Infrastructure and Water Supply
* Establish a rolling 3/6/12\-month look\-ahead programme and identify critical activities, dependencies and resource requirements
* Lead resource planning and allocation across labour, materials, equipment and project teams based on project priorities and upcoming work fronts
* Coordinate with project teams, contractors, consultants and APCRDA stakeholders to resolve programme constraints, resource bottlenecks, interfaces and critical\-path issues
* Provide programme\-level dashboards, progress reports, variance analysis and management alerts to APCRDA and PgMC leadership
* Ensure integration of planning, construction progress, contracts, resources and risk/issue management across the portfolio
* Build and lead a multi\-disciplinary planning team, including recruitment and ramp\-up, deployment, performance management and coordination of planning personnel across projects
* Single point of contact for APCRDA/PMU on all planning, scheduling and progress\-recovery matters within the function
* Support senior management in prioritisation, acceleration and recovery strategies to improve overall programme performance
* Maintain the risk and change register for the function and escalate matters beyond delegated authority to the Program Director


**Key mandate:** 
 ramp up the PgMC planning function → integrate and manage 95 contracts/projects → build and manage the planning team → establish programme controls → identify delays and constraints → drive recovery and acceleration → provide reliable management visibility on programme performance.

title: Deputy Manager - B&M (Category Management)
description:
The Deputy Manager – Buying \& Merchandising (Category Management) will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, category performance management and commercial execution for the Footwear category.
   

  

 The role will be responsible for translating category and business requirements into effective assortments, tracking seasonal deliveries, monitoring sell\-through and category performance, supporting End of Season Sale (EOSS) planning, and providing actionable insights at store, region, gender, style and size levels.
   

  

 The position will work closely with Buying, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Marketing, Planning, Product Development and Store teams to ensure successful execution of the seasonal category strategy.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Season Range Planning \& Assortment
* Support the development of seasonal range plans and assortment architecture for the Footwear category.
* Assist in building the right assortment based on category objectives, consumer preferences, store potential, historical performance and business requirements.
* Support assortment decisions across gender, category, style, size, price point and store grades.
* Participate in seasonal product conferences and contribute to product and assortment discussions.
* Identify assortment gaps and opportunities based on sales trends, market insights and category performance.
* Seasonal Product \& Delivery Management
* Take ownership of tracking seasonal product deliveries for the respective category.
* Monitor delivery timelines against the agreed seasonal calendar and highlight potential delays or gaps.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure timely availability of products across channels and stores.
* Maintain and update seasonal product trackers and provide regular visibility on delivery status.
* Buying \& Merchandise Planning
* Support the Buying Manager in developing seasonal buy plans aligned with category and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain seasonal buy forms, catalogues and relevant merchandising documentation.
* Support merchandise planning to ensure the right product, quantity and assortment is available across stores and channels.
* Monitor inventory and sell\-through trends and provide recommendations for corrective actions wherever required.
* Category Performance \& Sell\-Through Management
* Monitor and analyse category performance on a periodic basis across regions, stores and store grades.
* Conduct detailed analysis at category, gender, style and size levels to identify key performance drivers and gaps.
* Track sell\-through and identify slow\-moving, underperforming and high\-performing products.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve category productivity and inventory efficiency.
* Monitor performance against agreed GM% and category deliverables and highlight deviations.
* End of Season Sale (EOSS)
* Support the Buying Manager in EOSS planning and execution for the Footwear category.
* Analyze inventory ageing, sell\-through and product performance to support markdown and liquidation decisions.
* Track EOSS performance and provide periodic updates on sales, inventory and sell\-through.
* Support identification of products requiring specific interventions to optimize inventory liquidation.
* Marketing \& Seasonal Initiatives
* Support the development and execution of the seasonal marketing calendar and key marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with Marketing and relevant stakeholders to ensure category priorities are incorporated into seasonal campaigns.
* Support the creation of merchandise display plans for new\-season products during the season.
* Ensure merchandising initiatives are aligned with product launches and category priorities.
* Product Knowledge \& Store Training
* Conduct product training sessions for store teams to enhance product knowledge and selling effectiveness.
* Build awareness of key product features, technologies, benefits and selling propositions among store staff.
* Work with Retail Operations and store teams to ensure effective communication of seasonal product launches and priorities.
* Product Development \& Channel Support
* Support new product development initiatives for key channels and business partners.
* Provide category and market inputs based on consumer trends, store\-level performance and sales insights.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to identify product opportunities and assortment requirements for specific channels/partners.
* Business Analytics \& Insights
* Perform periodic, in\-depth analysis of category performance across:
+ Region
+ Store and store grade
+ Category
+ Gender
+ Style
+ Size
+ Sell\-through
+ Inventory/productivity

* Identify trends, opportunities and risks and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Prepare and present category performance reports and insights to relevant stakeholders.
* Support data\-driven decision\-making for range, assortment, replenishment and EOSS planning.


**Key Stakeholder Interfaces**
**The Role Will Work Closely With**
* Buying \& Merchandising
* Retail Operations
* Planning \& Allocation
* Marketing
* Product Development
* Finance
* Supply Chain
* Store Teams
* Key Channel / Business Partners


**Role Specifications**
**Qualification**
* Graduate from FDDI preferred.
* Additional qualification in Fashion, Retail, Merchandising, Business Management or a related discipline will be an advantage.


**Experience**
* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Buying \& Merchandising / Category Management, preferably within the Footwear, Fashion, Sportswear or Lifestyle Retail industry.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and category performance management will be preferred.


**Key Competencies**
**Functional Competencies**
* Season range planning and assortment building
* Category management
* Sell\-through management
* Merchandise planning
* EOSS planning and execution
* Category and store\-level performance analysis
* Style and size\-level analysis
* Inventory and assortment productivity
* GM% management
* Product knowledge and merchandising

**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead and manage a team of structural steel detailers and modelers.

* Support continuous improvement in detailing productivity, quality, and workflow.
* Assist management in evaluating team performance and technical capability.



  





**Required Experience \& Skills** 



* Strong professional experience in
 **structural steel detailing and 3D modeling** 
 .
* Strong understanding of structural steel fabrication and erection practices.
* Experience preparing and reviewing:
* 3D steel models
* General Arrangement drawings
* Shop/fabrication drawings
* Erection drawings
* Assembly and single\-part drawings
* Material/Bolt lists and BOMs
* Strong understanding of structural drawings, architectural drawings, design documents, and project specifications.
* Ability to identify clashes, missing information, detailing errors, and fabrication issues.

* Experience leading, mentoring, or supervising steel detailing teams.

* Good written and verbal communication skills.

* Diploma or degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related discipline.

* Experience working with commercial, industrial, warehouse, infrastructure, or miscellaneous steel projects.

 The successful candidate will be expected to act as the technical and delivery leader for the detailing team.

title: Assistant Planning Manager
description:
**Life tastes better with ice cream**
 With 19\.000 expert ice cream colleagues and iconic brands like Wall’s, Cornetto and Ben \& Jerry’s, loved in 76 countries, we are the world’s largest Ice Cream company leading the industry.
   

  

 We create iconic ice cream brands that are part of everyday life, bringing moments of joy to millions of people around the world. Everybody loves ice cream. And as the world’s biggest pure‑play ice cream company, we have the scale and ambition to make a real difference.
   

  

**What Truly Sets Us Apart Is How We Work.**
 We move fast and keep things simple. We turn ideas into action, trust people to take ownership, and work as one team to win together with integrity. Our culture is high‑performance, collaborative and focused on getting things done.
   

  

 We’re curious and ready for what’s next. We embrace digital, use data to make better decisions, and keep learning, including how AI can help us work smarter and serve consumers better.
   

  

 The role The Assistant Manager\- Planning is responsible for the day\-to\-day operational excellence and delivery of the Forecast\-to\-Plan (F2P) lifecycle across the multiple regions. This role acts as the critical bridge between global process standards and regional execution, ensuring that the Third\-Party Service Provider (3PSP) performs planning activities at the keystroke level with precision, speed, and alignment to business goals. The Operations Lead focuses on "running the engine"—managing the vendor relationship, troubleshooting regional supply chain bottlenecks, and ensuring that demand forecasting, supply planning, and S\&OP cycles are executed accurately What you'll be responsible for 1\. Operational Oversight \& Vendor Management 3PSP Coordination: Act as the primary point of escalation and coordination for the 3PSP vendor; ensuring their delivery of demand forecasting, supply planning, and inventory management meets all contractual requirements. Keystroke\-Level Governance: Monitor the quality of the vendor’s execution within planning systems (e.g., SAP IBP, Kinaxis), ensuring data entry and process steps align with the Global Process Owner’s (GPO) standards. Service Delivery: Oversee the timely completion of regional planning cycles, including the weekly/monthly drumbeat for Demand and Supply reviews. 2\. Regional Performance \& Execution KPI Accountability: Own the regional delivery of F2P metrics for EU, specifically: Forecast Accuracy, Forecast Bias, Inventory Health (DIO), and On\-Time In\-Full (OTIF) service levels. Operational Reviews: Lead weekly and monthly operational performance reviews with the 3PSP and regional stakeholders to address variances and drive corrective actions. Exception Management: Proactively identify and resolve regional supply\-demand imbalances, coordinating between the vendor and local markets to mitigate stock\-outs or excess inventory. 3\. Process Localization \& Compliance Standardization Adherence: Ensure the operations remain 100% aligned with the global F2P framework designed by the GPO, minimizing "local\-only" deviations unless business\-critical. Documentation \& Knowledge: Maintain regional operational playbooks and ensure the 3PSP keeps all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Desktop Procedures (DTPs) updated and accurate. Audit \& Controls: Ensure all planning activities in the region comply with internal controls, SOX requirements, and data privacy standards. 4\. Technology \& Tactical Enablement System Utilization: Ensure the 3PSP is fully utilizing the capabilities of SAP S/4HANA and planning platforms; identifying technical training gaps or system glitches that hinder regional performance. User Acceptance Testing (UAT): Lead regional UAT for any new system deployments or upgrades, ensuring that EU\-specific market nuances are captured before "Go\-Live." Data Integrity: Oversee the hygiene of master data (lead times, safety stocks, MOQs) managed by the vendor to ensure planning outputs are reliable. 5\. Stakeholder \& Cross\-Functional Alignment Regional Bridge: Act as the operational liaison between Commercial teams, Regional Finance, and the Global GPO team. S\&OP Integration: Facilitate the regional S\&OP/IBP forums, ensuring the vendor provides the necessary data transparency and scenario modeling to support executive decision\-making. Conflict Resolution: Resolve operational trade\-offs between commercial demand and supply constraints. We're looking for someone who Experiences \& Qualifications University degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field. 10\+ years of experience in Supply Chain operations, with a heavy focus on Demand and Supply Planning. Significant track record managing 3PSPs or BPO partners in a high\-volume, keystroke\-level environment. High "Super\-User" comfort level with SAP S/4HANA and advanced planning tools (e.g., SAP IBP, Kinaxis, or OMP). Ability to dissect complex datasets to identify the root cause of forecast bias or inventory stock\-outs. Experience navigating the diverse market landscape of multiple markets and managing stakeholders across different time zones and languages. What you'll get Alongside meaningful work and strong development, we offer a reward package that typically includes Market\-competitive pay and performance related rewards Flexible ways of working Support for health, wellbeing and life outside of work Time off to rest and recharge Ongoing learning and development opportunities Specific benefits vary by location
   

  

**Why join us?**
 This is a place for people who are passionate about ice cream and are growth obsessed \- both for the business and for themselves. People who act like an owner and drive our business end\-to\-end. People who are driven by success to deliver more than we ever thought we could!
   

  

 You’ll thrive here if you value an inclusive culture, with low ego and hierarchy \- and if you’re excited to continuously learn and challenge how we work, using digital, data, and new thinking to push us forward.
   

  

* Roles with real accountability and visible impact
* Free to move fast, experiment and challenge how things are done
* Continuous learning and development as the business grows
* Reward linked to performance and contribution.


 Your career here is shaped by what you deliver, as you work across functions and markets and grow with the business.
   

  

**Ready to build the future of Ice Cream?**
 If this sounds like the place where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you. Apply online and share your CV. We'll review your application and be in touch with the next steps.
   

  

 If you are an individual with a disability and require assistance at any time during our recruitment process, please let your Talent Acquisition Partner know.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 The Magnum Ice Cream Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work regardless of age, disability, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic.

title: Supply Chain Management Manager - Operations
description:

 **Supply Chain Manager – Operations at BSM** 
 , you will be responsible for supporting and enhancing the Group’s strategic goals by ensuring uninterrupted delivery of goods and services, maintaining compliance with global standards, and strengthening the connection between ship and shore operations. This role is pivotal in driving efficiency, transparency, and value creation across procurement and supply chain functions, while fostering strong vendor relationships and optimizing operational performance.

* Consolidate survey data from customer satisfaction and supplier evaluations to drive improvement initiatives.
* Maintain supplier base by building strong relationships, reviewing contracts, and collaborating with suppliers for knowledge sharing and inventory optimization.
* Strengthen vendor database through systematic monitoring, dispute resolution, and blacklisting management.
* Review procurement policies to recommend improvements and prevent grey market sourcing.
* Facilitate communication between buying, fleet, logistics, and administration teams to ensure uniform processes and budget alignment.
* Analyze supply chain data including vendor databases, contracts, spend patterns, and budget variances to prepare intelligence reports.
* Optimize logistics for efficient consolidation and delivery of goods to warehouses and vessels.
* Manage procurement catalog by maintaining item master data and vendor information accurately.
* Conduct vendor audits and support audit requirements with consolidated data.
* Onboard new suppliers and ensure timely updates of supplier information.
* Resolve disputes fairly between vendors, clients, and stakeholders.
* Support training initiatives for staff, vendors, and seafarers to enhance awareness of tools, processes, and best practices.
* Promote supplier engagement through meetings, timely responses, and risk mitigation.
* Contribute to system enhancements and group\-wide projects for continuous improvement.


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Mandatory requirement: mariner background with sea‑going experience.
* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or related field.
* Professional certifications in procurement or supply chain (e.g., CIPS, CPSM) preferred.
* Proven experience in procurement, vendor management, and supply chain operations.
* Strong background in compliance, auditing, and performance monitoring.


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Analytical skills for data consolidation, reporting, and decision support.
* Relationship management to build trust and collaboration with suppliers and stakeholders.
* Problem\-solving to resolve disputes and mitigate risks effectively.
* Communication skills for clear coordination across teams and external partners.
* Strategic thinking to align procurement initiatives with organizational goals.
* Adaptability to support continuous improvement and system enhancements.

* Diverse workforce.
* Technology\-driven company.
* Be a part of the ever\-growing Schulte group family!

title: DCEO Engineer, DCEO
description:
**Description**
 AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
   

  

 You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
   

  

 AWS Infrastructure Services owns and operates global data center facilities that require skilled maintenance engineers to ensure continuous operations. We're expanding our team to include Mechanical Service Engineers who will be responsible for critical infrastructure maintenance and operations. This position will serve as the primary technical resource for mechanical and HVAC systems maintenance within AWS data centers in India. The role requires hands\-on management of mechanical infrastructure, including preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, and emergency response. The position will require 24x7 on\-call support and rotational shifts (need basis general shift).
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Operations And Maintenance**
* Ownership of all Data Center changes/events/incidents/problems from beginning to end as well as overseeing the completion of post\-mortems, root cause analysis and follow\-up resolution actions.
* Responsible for ensuring maintenance/ repairs of site\-critical facility infrastructure or a Data Center are planned and executed to the best interest of the business.
* Responsible for Asset and Inventory management.
* Develop and maintain method statements, standard operating procedures, emergency response procedures, preventive maintenance programs, and all technical documentation.
* Ensure standardization and consistency with best\-in\-class operating practices. (Technical Writing Skills and Automation)
* Communicate operating philosophies, technical information, objectives and expectations to Amazon personnel and to the vendor critical facilities management teams.
* Providing hands on facility support where required


**Incident And Emergency Response**
* Reviewing incident reports, documenting periodic trend summaries, and providing updates and recommended actions to management.
* Managing information flow during incidents while providing regular updates to management.
* Manage and coordinate with vendors to resolve any incidents during emergency situations. This may require to physically be dispatched on to site to investigate and resolve the issue.
* Ensure 24\*7 shift operations in safe, secure manner without availability impact.


 A day in the life
   

  

* Troubleshoot facility and rack\-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA).
* Perform rack installs, rack decommissioning, and facility MEP management.

title: Application Manager
description:
Position Summary
 



 We are seeking an experienced
 **Application Manager** 
 with a strong technical foundation to manage a portfolio of enterprise and Pharma applications. This role combines Application Management Services (AMS), application lifecycle governance, stakeholder coordination, operational service ownership, and awareness of GxP controls applicable to regulated applications.
 



 The successful candidate will ensure application stability, compliant change execution, service performance, lifecycle planning, and effective coordination across business, quality, technical, infrastructure, security, and vendor teams.
 



**Ideal Profile:** 
 A technically grounded application professional who can connect service operations, lifecycle decisions, compliance expectations, and business outcomes.
 



 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Application Service Ownership
 


* Own end\-to\-end operational management of assigned applications and act as the primary coordination point for service delivery.
* Oversee incidents, service requests, problems, changes, releases, knowledge, and recurring operational activities.
* Monitor service levels, operational health, risks, dependencies, and improvement actions.
* Coordinate major incident response, technical troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, and follow\-through on corrective actions.



 2\. Application Lifecycle Management
 


* Manage the application lifecycle from onboarding and transition through BAU support, upgrades, roadmap planning, and retirement.
* Maintain application inventory, ownership, support model, lifecycle status, technical dependencies, documentation, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate patching, upgrades, releases, testing, deployment, and post\-implementation support with relevant teams.
* Identify technical debt, end\-of\-life risks, support gaps, and opportunities for modernization or simplification.



 3\. GxP and Compliance Awareness
 


* Understand the impact of GxP controls on application support, access, documentation, testing, change, release, and incident processes.
* Ensure changes to regulated applications follow applicable quality, validation, approval, traceability, and evidence requirements.
* Work with Quality, Compliance, Validation, Security, and Business teams to maintain application control readiness.
* Support audit and inspection requests by ensuring records, approvals, evidence, and operational documentation are complete and retrievable.
* Assist with compliance deviations, remediation actions, and risk tracking when required.



 4\. Stakeholder and Vendor Management
 


* Engage application owners, business users, product teams, technical teams, and external vendors to maintain service continuity.
* Lead service reviews and communicate service performance, risks, issues, dependencies, and improvement plans.
* Coordinate vendor deliverables, escalations, support obligations, and technical actions.
* Translate business priorities into clear operational and technical requirements.



 5\. Continuous Improvement and Governance
 


* Drive service improvement, automation, knowledge maturity, monitoring enhancements, and reduction of recurring issues.
* Maintain governance artefacts, operational procedures, support documentation, and management reporting.
* Ensure risks, actions, decisions, and exceptions are documented and tracked to closure.



  





 Required Experience and Skills
 



  





 8\+ years of overall IT experience, with substantial experience in application support, application management, or AMS delivery.
 



 Good understanding of application architecture, interfaces, APIs, databases, middleware, hosting, cloud/SaaS services, security, and production support practices.
 



 Strong working knowledge of incident, problem, change, release, service request, knowledge, SLA/KPI, and continuous improvement processes.
 



 Experience managing application onboarding, transition, maintenance, upgrades, releases, risk, technical debt, roadmap, and retirement activities.
 



 Awareness of GxP controls and the importance of validated processes, controlled changes, traceability, evidence, access governance, data integrity, and audit readiness for regulated applications.
 



 Ability to work confidently with business, quality, compliance, security, infrastructure, development, support, and vendor stakeholders.
 



 Strong written and verbal communication, governance, prioritization, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.

title: Technical Manager - Zendesk ( 6 months contractual role)
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a high\-impact Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, evolution, and technical stability of our Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem. Having completed a migration from Salesforce to Zendesk Enterprise, we are now building a proactive, automated, high\-efficiency CRM.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as the "Enterprise Systems \& AI Product Owner." You will lead a team of two Zendesk Specialists, collaborate directly with enterprise clients to scope API integrations, and drive cross\-functional engineering projects. You will be responsible for turning Zendesk into an AI\-enabled workspace—deploying Zendesk Copilot, AI Agents for deflection, Zendesk AutoQA, Zendesk WFM, Glean Enterprise Search, and Gemini LLM integrations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic AI Ecosystem \& Native Zendesk Optimization**
* Autonomous AI Deflection: Build, optimize, and oversee Zendesk AI Agents (Bots) to increase self\-service resolution rates for Tier\-1 inquiries.
* Agent Copilot \& Productivity: Architect and fine\-tune Zendesk Copilot (Auto\-Assist workflows, real\-time ticket summarization, and suggested next actions) to reduce Average Handle Time (AHT) and cognitive load.
* 100% Automated Quality Governance: Established Zendesk AutoQA scorecards and automated grading logic to continuously evaluate 100% of human and bot interactions, using sentiment analysis to flag churn risks and coaching opportunities.
* Workforce Management (WFM): Oversee Zendesk WFM (Tymeshift) configuration to transition from reactive staffing to data\-driven, predictive capacity planning.


**Platform Architecture \& Tool Integrations (Glean / Gemini)**
* Enterprise AI \& Search Readiness: Partner with engineering and data teams to connect enterprise search tools (Glean) directly into Zendesk so agents can search across Confluence, Drive, and internal tools from a single workspace.
* Gemini LLM Workflows: Build data pipelines and API hooks to connect Gemini/LLMs for predictive retention modeling, automated drafts, and custom object field enrichment.
* Internal Tool Middleware: Oversee integrations between Zendesk, internal ERPs, product databases, and middleware (e.g., Webhooks) to create a single 360\-degree CRM workspace.


**Customer API Discovery \& Developer Experience**
* External Client Solutions: Interface directly with strategic business clients and account executives to gather technical requirements for direct API access, custom webhooks, and dedicated customer portal integrations.
* Developer Experience: Partner with internal software engineers to maintain clean, secure, rate\-managed, and well\-documented Zendesk REST APIs for customer usage.


**Governance, Stability \& Knowledge Architecture**
* Environment Governance: Establish strict Sandbox\-to\-Production release pipelines, manage API rate limits, audit trigger loops, and ensure compliance (GDPR/Data Privacy).
* Knowledge Architecture (KCS): Lead a Knowledge\-Centered Service strategy to consolidate company\-wide documentation into a structured source of truth indexed within Zendesk.
* Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor 2 Zendesk Specialists, managing sprint planning, task prioritization, and platform issue triage.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years in Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or CX Platform Ownership.
* Zendesk Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex Zendesk instances, including Sandbox environments, Custom Objects, Omnichannel Routing, Copilot, AI Agents (Bots), AutoQA, and WFM.
* Integration \& API Technical Depth: Proven experience with REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, OAuth, Postman, and middleware integration tools (Workato, Zapier, n8n).
* AI \& Search Engines: Hands\-on experience or technical project delivery involving Enterprise Search (e.g., Glean, Coveo) and LLMs (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI).
* Client Engagement: Ability to run discovery meetings directly with tech teams to translate business needs into clear technical specifications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Zendesk Certified Systems Architect.
* Demonstrated track record implementing Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) principles across multi\-department teams.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

 We are looking for an experienced Senior Agent\- Transportation to manage and coordinate transportation operations as part of our Supply Chain and 3rd\-Party Contract Logistics (3PL) function. The role will be responsible for ensuring smooth, timely, cost\-effective, and compliant movement of goods through transportation partners and logistics service providers.
   

  

 The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in transportation planning, 3PL operations, transporter/vendor management, shipment tracking, delivery performance, cost control, and operational issue resolution. The candidate will work closely with internal Supply Chain, Warehouse, Customer Service, Procurement, Finance, and external logistics partners to ensure high service levels.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Transportation Operations**
* Manage day\-to\-day transportation activities, including primary and secondary transportation movements.
* Coordinate with 3PL partners, transporters, fleet operators, and other logistics service providers.
* Plan and monitor vehicle placement, shipment dispatch, route allocation, and delivery schedules.
* Ensure timely pickup and delivery of shipments in line with agreed SLA/KPI requirements.
* Monitor shipment status and proactively identify and resolve delays, route deviations, vehicle issues, and delivery exceptions.
* Ensure proper documentation for transportation movements, including e\-way bills, PODs, invoices, delivery documents, and other statutory requirements.

* Monitor transporter performance against agreed SLAs and KPIs.
* Conduct regular performance reviews with logistics partners and drive corrective actions.

* Support evaluation and onboarding of new transportation vendors as required.


**Cost \& Performance Management**

* Track key transportation KPIs such as:
+ On\-Time Delivery (OTD)
+ On\-Time Pickup
+ Vehicle Placement
+ Transit Time
+ Freight Cost per Shipment / KM
+ Vehicle Utilization
+ Delivery Exceptions
+ POD Compliance

* Prepare regular transportation performance reports and dashboards.


 C
 **ompliance \& Risk Management**
* Ensure transportation activities comply with applicable Indian statutory, regulatory, safety, and company requirements.
* Ensure documentation and records are maintained accurately.
* Coordinate with transporters to address compliance, safety, and operational risks.
* Escalate critical operational or compliance issues to management in a timely manner.


**Continuous Improvement**
* Identify opportunities to improve transportation processes, service levels, and cost efficiency.
* Drive initiatives related to route optimization, load consolidation, vehicle utilization, automation, and process standardization.
* Participate in logistics and supply chain improvement projects.


**Required Qualifications**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in transportation, logistics, supply chain, distribution, or 3PL operations.
* Experience working with 3PL/contract logistics companies and transportation vendors in India.
* Strong understanding of transportation and distribution operations.
* Good knowledge of Indian transportation practices, documentation, and statutory requirements.
* Experience with ERP/TMS/ systems and MS Excel.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and vendor\-management skills.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience in FMCG, Retail, E\-commerce, Manufacturing, Consumer Goods, Automotive, Pharma, or other distribution\-intensive industries.
* Experience managing multiple transporters and logistics partners.
* Exposure to contract logistics, freight management, route planning, and transportation cost analysis.
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and supply chain analytics.
* Experience handling high\-volume shipments and time\-sensitive deliveries.


**Key Competencies**
* Transportation \& Distribution Management
* 3PL / Contract Logistics Management
* Transporter \& Vendor Management
* Supply Chain Operations
* Route \& Capacity Planning
* Cost Optimization
* KPI / SLA Management
* Data Analysis \& Reporting
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Continuous Improvement


**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**
* On\-Time Delivery / OTD

* Vehicle Placement Adherence
* Transportation Cost vs. Budget
* Vehicle Utilization
* Transit Time Adherence
* POD Compliance
* Transporter SLA Performance

 The Company
   

  

 FedEx Logistics provides e\-Commerce, freight forwarding, as well as import and export services that allow companies to reach markets throughout the world. They help customers of all sizes solve the intricacies of shipping goods globally by providing comprehensive international ocean and air freight forwarding, surface transportation and distribution, customs brokerage, trade and customs advisory services, and advanced e\-commerce and trade facilitation solutions.
   

  

 The Philosophy
   

  

 People–Service–Profit (P\-S\-P). We take care of our People so that they can deliver impeccable Service to our customers who will give us the Profit necessary for FedEx to be successful. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages employees to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for our employees' well\-being and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 The Culture
   

  

 We honor innovation, integrity and diversity. We have many formal policies, procedures and programs to bring out the best in our staff, individually and in teams.
   

  

 The Mission
   

  

 We strive to be the Best Company to work for with the Best Service and the Best Brand in our industry.
   

  

 We're glad you stopped by and hope your job search experience with FedEx Logistics, Inc. will be rewarding. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Production Support Lead Analyst
description:
Unlike other organisations, FNZ encourages employees to explore internal career opportunities across the organisation. An FNZer's career pathway isn't restricted to linear progression and often our top talent have worked across a multitude of business functions. As such, we don't restrict applications based on tenure however you mustn't have any performance issues and you must inform your current Line Manager before applying.
   

  

**Role Overview**
 The
 **Production Support Lead Analyst** 
 is the
 **operational leader and primary accountability owner for platform stability** 
 across one or more FNZ platforms. This role provides day‑to‑day leadership for the Production Support team, ensures consistent operational standards, and leads incident response and stability improvements.
   

  

 This is a
 **player‑coach role** 
 : the Lead Analyst is expected to provide strong people leadership and operational governance, while remaining hands‑on during major incidents, complex investigations, and critical decision points.
   

  

 The role works closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts, Developers, and global operational teams to ensure high‑quality service outcomes, effective incident management, and continuous improvement of platform reliability.
   

  

**Team Responsibilities**
* Oversee daily checks, recoveries, and platform reliability activities, ensuring consistency and quality across the Analyst team.
* Lead and coordinate incident response, ensuring correct triage, timely escalations, and alignment with operational playbooks.
* Ensure SOPs, runbooks, monitoring rules, and KB articles across all supported platforms remain current and high‑quality.
* Review and validate RCAs, ensuring they are accurate, complete, and delivered within required timelines.
* Drive preventive actions, stability improvements, and operational maturity uplift across supported platforms.
* Act as the primary liaison between Analysts, Senior Analysts, Developers, and global operational teams.
* Lead operational reporting, SLA/KPI tracking, and present key insights in operational reviews.
* Coach Analysts and Senior Analysts, building investigation discipline, platform knowledge, and operational excellence.


**Specific Role Responsibilities**
* Proven experience managing and leading teams of 8–10\+ members, including workload planning, performance oversight, coaching, and capability development.
* Provide day‑to‑day leadership to Analysts and Senior Analysts, managing task allocation, priority handling, and operational workload.
* Oversee all daily platform checks, validations, and recovery tasks performed by the team, ensuring accuracy and timely completion.
* Lead incident bridges when required, ensuring structured investigation, evidence capture, technical analysis, and clear communication.
* Validate and sign off RCAs for assigned platforms, ensuring actionable follow‑ups, accuracy, and alignment with Problem Management standards.
* Proactively identify patterns, recurring incidents, and operational inefficiencies; drive corrective actions with Developers and platform owners.
* Maintain high‑quality SOPs, runbooks, and operational artifacts, ensuring consistency across regions and teams.
* Provide escalation support to Analysts during complex investigations and decision‑making scenarios.
* Support client‑facing communications by reviewing technical details and ensuring accuracy and clarity.
* Represent Production Support in cross‑functional forums, including change reviews, operational meetings, and platform discussions.
* Maintain strong oversight of SLAs, KPIs, and risk controls, ensuring timely reporting and highlighting risks proactively.
* Facilitate continuous learning and capability uplift within the team through structured coaching, feedback, and knowledge sharing.


**Leadership \& Development**
* Lead, mentor, and guide a dedicated application support team.
* Monitor team performance and continuously seek improvement opportunities for skills and processes.
* Develop, maintain, and ensure adherence to comprehensive documentation on team activities.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure that business objectives and needs are met.
* Contribute to audit and effectiveness requests.


**Experience Required**
**What we are looking for:**
* 8\+ years of experience in Production Support, Application Support, Platform Operations, or similar roles.
* Strong leadership experience in coordinating investigations, task allocation, and operational workflows.
* Excellent SQL and diagnostic capability with hands‑on experience analyzing logs, workflows, and platform behavior.
* Proven track record of managing major incidents, leading bridges, and driving structured investigations.
* Strong grounding in ITIL practices, especially Incident, Problem, and Change Management.
* Demonstrated experience in delivering or overseeing platform checks, recoveries, and reliability governance.
* Ability to mentor Analysts/Senior Analysts and lead team capability uplift.
* Strong communication skills for stakeholder coordination, documentation, RCA review, and operational reporting.
* Experience with monitoring and operational tooling (Splunk, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, New Relic, etc.).
* Experience in driving automation initiatives and operational efficiency programs.
* Prior experience establishing operational processes, frameworks, or cross‑team collaboration practices.


**Experience Preferred**
**Beneficial but not essential.**
* Exposure to financial domain, investment workflows, or complex multi‑system architectures.
* Familiarity with .NET, SQL Server, APIs, or microservice architectures.


 For advertising:
 **Opportunities**
**What Do We Offer**
* We are mission led \- work at the heart of a purpose\-led organization, where you can be proud of the impact you make, every day. Where you’ll transform the way over 20 million people invest, making wealth management more accessible, sustainable and transparent to more people.
* Rapid career growth \- encouraged to take on responsibility, play a part in the evolution of the company and rapidly drive your career development working on real projects that directly impact our clients and their customers.
* Market leading technology \- Build, create and evolve innovative solutions for the world’s most trusted brands using the latest technologies to help change the face of investing for the future
* Learning \& development – Placing emphasis on a willingness to learn, to think differently, to be creative and to help drive innovation.


**About FNZ**
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end\-to\-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2\.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
   

  

 Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

****Position Description****

 CSM AgChem

 Team Technical Services (Site)

 Junior Management
